fields.why: Within each sex, year-over-year changes are compared and ranked across five age groups (most pronounced decreases among ages >=65 and 25-34), and monthly counts are shown for each group.
Age (five groups within sex) is the only SPD with 3+ groups; sex has two.
The CI-vs-1 judgments test each group's period VR, not differences across age groups, and no interaction is tested; the cross-age ranking is side by side. The mechanical flag is a false alarm.

brief_issues: Rule F4 gives interaction and joinpoint APCs as examples of time trends compared across SPD groups; it could say explicitly that a ranking of per-group period changes with no cross-group test is a side-by-side entry.
